title: Reference dataset manifest
description: Validated by scripts/ingest.py before a source is ingested.

source.description: Registry folder name; must match sources/<source>/.

source_tier.description: 1=primary/regulator .. 4=weak. Tier>=2 caps confidence below green when this is the only source.

scraped_date.description: ISO date of the scrape; goes in report_citation + README.

oid_field.description: Source property used as the stable id.

adapter.description: Optional. 'adapter.py:ClassName' subclassing AdapterBase. Omit for pure-declarative sources.

name.description: Dataset key within this source (e.g. oil, gas).

scraped_date.description: Per-dataset scrape date; overrides provenance.scraped_date in report_citation.

commodity_default.description: Used when a row has no fuel_field, or fuel_map misses.

path.description: Relative to the source folder (e.g. data/foo.geojson).

geometry.description: feature = on each GeoJSON/shapefile feature; wkt_column = a WKT string column; none = attributes only.

crs.description: Overrides default_crs for this dataset if its source CRS differs.

column_map.description: canonical field -> source property name. *_const keys carry a literal value instead.

length_commodity_quirk.description: Marks a source where length unit differs by commodity (e.g. GulfPub oil = miles).

status_map.description: source status string -> GEM lowercase Status vocab.

ignore_garbage_fields.description: Source properties to drop defensively (e.g. ESRI Shape_STLe, which is NOT a usable length).

matching.description: Per-DATASET tuning, layered over the source-level `matching`. Use this when one country's extract behaves differently from the rest of the source: source weights are global, so retuning them to fix one country silently rewrites every already-committed run of that source.
Optional tuning; engine defaults apply when omitted. Resolution order: engine DEFAULTS <- source `matching` <- dataset `matching`.

geoarea_weight.description: Weight on the admin-area signal (scripts/geo_signals.py): the reference trace's Natural Earth admin-0/admin-1 footprint vs the GEM row's declared Start/End Country + State/Province + Prefecture/District. DEFAULT 0.0 = OFF, so enabling this feature moves no already-committed composite. Turn it on for sources whose features are largely unnamed (OSM), where it is often the only live signal.

geometry_untested_score.description: Stand-in g_score when the reference has geometry but the GEM candidate has no route, so the geometry test could not run. Low (the match is unverified) but non-zero (absent geometry is not evidence against).

near_miss_delta.description: A best match scoring within this much BELOW yellow_threshold is bucketed as a near miss for human review rather than silently reported as a source-only Addition. A false Addition masks a real one.

route_containment_threshold.description: Fraction of an unmatched reference trace lying inside a GEM route at/above which it is dispositioned FRAGMENT_OF_EXISTING (a partial trace of a tracked line) instead of DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE. Containment, not IoU: a short trace sitting exactly on a long GEM route scores near-zero IoU.

spatial_candidates.description: GEM rows pulled into the geometry pass by PROXIMITY, unioned with the attribute-ranked top-K. Without this the geometry candidates are chosen by an attribute ranking that is meaningless when the reference is unnamed.
